title: The SOURCE: Syracuse Office of Undergraduate Research and Creative Engagement
description:
The SOURCE (Syracuse Office of Undergraduate Research and Creative Engagement) fosters and supports diverse undergraduate participation in faculty-guided scholarly research and creative inquiry across every school and college at Syracuse University. Based in Bird Library, it is the campus hub for finding a faculty mentor, applying for research funding, and getting started in research or creative work in any discipline.
